sessions.phase_label: Initial demand drafting, approval, and dispatch
Certified-delivery tracking, remailing, and escalation drafting
Escalation timing, delivery outcomes, and engagement closeout

requirements.title: Formal Demand Letter
requirements.definition: Draft and finalize a formal demand and notice-of-default letter on the freelancer's letterhead that cites the relevant agreements, states the debt and enforcement position, and addresses the intended borrowers.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the content, addressees, review, and finalization of the initial demand document; physical delivery and borrower-facing email transmission are independently executable Requirements.

requirements.title: Certified-Mail Delivery of Demand Letters
requirements.definition: Send certified USPS copies of the demand letter to the required addresses, retain delivery evidence, and use client-approved replacement or alternate addresses when an attempted delivery fails.
requirements.boundary_note: The number of copies, destination addresses, proof of delivery, and approved remailings are attributes of one certified-delivery mechanism; drafting the letter and emailing it are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Initial Borrower Email Notice
requirements.definition: Send both borrowers an accompanying email with the demand letter, notify them of the certified mailing, and copy the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the initial electronic notice accompanying the original demand; later proactive escalation correspondence and replies to future borrower responses have different triggers and trajectories.

requirements.title: Borrower Response Handling
requirements.definition: Handle up to three email exchanges if the borrowers respond, using replies drafted by the client and sent by the freelancer on the client's behalf.
requirements.boundary_note: This obligation is conditional on incoming borrower responses and is separate from the proactive escalation notice later prepared after no response was received.

requirements.title: Proactive Escalation Follow-Up Notice
requirements.definition: Prepare, obtain client approval for, and send a proactive follow-up or escalation notice after the borrowers fail to respond, including the agreed delivery-history and updated-balance details.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a proactive second notice triggered by nonresponse and later described as beyond the original scope; it is not one of the contingent replies to an incoming borrower message.
